events.description: A man in a green jacket physically assaults another man on the ground, striking him repeatedly while he is down.
The victim on the ground is clearly helpless and pleading ('Stop! Stop!'), while being struck—this constitutes abuse rather than mutual combat.
Two men engage in a physical struggle on a dock; one grabs the other and pushes him toward the water.
One man forcefully shoves another who appears unable to resist effectively, culminating in being thrown over the railing—this is an act of abuse during the fight sequence.
A man in a black leather jacket is seen repeatedly striking or pressing down on a person wearing a green jacket who is on the ground, indicating an attack on a helpless victim.
A man lies on the ground with visible blood on his face and shirt, appearing injured and unconscious, consistent with having been assaulted.

A man in a black leather jacket is shown swinging a large object (possibly a weapon or tool) toward the ground where the injured man lies, followed by frames showing the injured man still lying motionless while others stand nearby — indicating continuation of assault or its immediate aftermath.
A man in a leather jacket is seen crouching over another man who is lying on the ground with visible facial injuries and blood, indicating an attack on a helpless victim.
A violent act occurs: a person swings a heavy object (appears to be a concrete block or similar) toward the head of the prone man; the motion blur and impact suggest a strike.

The injured man remains on the ground, surrounded by multiple individuals who are leaning over him, grabbing his clothing and body, while he shows signs of pain and distress; this constitutes ongoing abuse of a helpless victim.
A group of four men lift and throw a fifth man (wearing black tank top) into the air in a coordinated, violent motion, consistent with a physical assault.
